title: TypeScript types can run DOOM
summary: The Michigan TypeScript group shows the Doom engine running entirely inside the TypeScript type system. It is open source, and two follow-up videos cover why and how they did it.
why: HN commenters link it as a delightful example of how far TypeScript types can be pushed, since they are Turing complete.

quote.text: I must link this wonderful video about TypeScript types running... DOOM.
